title: hard/certs/claim-0N.rediscuss.json, KEVM re-discharge invocation (variant A)
description: Not a proof object. The verifier builds the whole docker/kprove command line itself (pilot/checker/run-claim.sh shape: --network none, claim dir read-only at /claim, fixed --definition and -I paths) and takes only claim_file, spec_module and kprove_args from here; kprove_args containing --definition, --directory, -d, --output-file or -o are refused. The image is the one T_hat names (checker 'kevm-prove'), matched by digest. 'expected' is informational: the verifier's own judge (ported from tcg/verdict.py) decides. Optional record fields (argv, image_id, k_commit, evm_semantics_commit, claim_file_sha256, ledger_seq) describe the producer's run. argv is never executed. If image_id is present it must be one of the T_hat kevm-prove hashes, and claim_file_sha256 must equal the claim file's hash; otherwise the invocation is malformed. No verdict field: the bundle carries no verdict (v3 section 4). The producer's exit code lives in the ledger event referenced by ledger_seq.

argv.description: exact command of the producer's recorded run; informational, never executed

ledger_seq.description: seq of the provenance/ledger.jsonl event that recorded the producer's run
